# Semlink 2.2.2

A small compliance release for the community checker's latest CSS rules. No user-facing behavior change.

## Checker compliance

- The "Reconfigure indexing" action on the Get Started screen is now a true text link (`<a>`) instead of a `<button>` restyled through `!important` overrides — eight `!important` declarations removed from styles.css (community checker's "Avoid !important" warnings).
- Keyboard access is preserved via the link's `href`; visual appearance is unchanged.
